Paperlogy webfont files

Source: https://github.com/fonts-archive/Paperlogy
Upstream distribution: https://freesentation.blog/paperlogyfont
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1

Mindex ships all Paperlogy weights 1-9.
Interface CSS should prefer odd weights for deliberate styling:
1 Thin, 3 Light, 5 Medium, 7 Bold, and 9 Black.
